title: 5 Minute vs. 5 Hour Vegan Tiramisu
summary: Goodful’s Merle leads viewers through two vegan tiramisu variations in a single video: a rapid 5-minute version built on a creamy silken tofu filling layered with crushed speculoos cookies and coffee, and a more traditional 5-hour version featuring a homemade vegan mascarpone, a sponge-like vegan ladyfinger cake, and espresso-dunked cake layers. The video provides ingredient lists, equipment, and time cues for each method, including blending the tofu filling, crumbling cookies, building layers in a jar for the quick version, baking and cooling a vegan sponge for the longer version, espresso-soaking and layering with mascarpone, followed by refrigeration to set. The tone is casual and encouraging, ending with tasting notes and a prompt for audience engagement.

sections.title: Five-minute vegan tiramisu
sections.description: Merle blends silken tofu with coconut milk, lemon juice, sugar, and vanilla to create a quick, creamy base, then builds a layered dessert in a mason jar using crushed speculoos cookies and a coffee mixture, finishing with raspberries.

sections.title: Five-hour vegan tiramisu (traditional-style)
sections.description: A more complex vegan tiramisu is assembled with a homemade vegan ladyfinger cake, a blender-made vegan mascarpone, and espresso-dunked layers. The cake is sliced, soaked in espresso with Marsala (or dark rum) and sugar, then layered with mascarpone in a dish and chilled for about three hours or overnight.

sections.title: Tasting and final thoughts
sections.description: Post-set, Merle tastes the final tiramisu, comments on flavor development and the value of the extra time for depth of flavor, and invites viewer feedback and future recipe ideas.
